automatic.title: Find your inverter
automatic.description: Detected networks: {networks}. Confirm or edit the private IPv4 range. Large networks use a suggested /24 range; you can scan another range up to /22. The search runs from Home Assistant, reads identification only and takes up to 45 seconds.

choose.title: Inverters found
choose.description: Select your inverter by serial number and IP address. Identification confirms a Deye-compatible inverter, not a particular dongle model.
